visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, bangs, and a red top stands in an indoor room with white shelves displaying numerous crystals and minerals behind her. She waves to the camera while holding a cardboard box and several shopping bags, smiling and looking directly at the lens. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of hands unboxing minerals. A large, brown, crystalline mineral is removed from a white box lined with white tissue paper. The hands rotate the crystal to show its facets under bright, direct lighting. (3) The camera focuses on a small white card with handwritten text and a bull logo, followed by the unboxing of three dark, prismatic crystals from white paper. Each is held up individually for a close-up inspection. (4) A spherical, white, sugar-like crystal is removed from a small plastic zip-lock bag and rotated between fingers to show its texture. The background shows other crystal boxes. (5) Hands unwrap a larger, semi-transparent smoky quartz crystal from brown crumpled paper secured with a rubber band. It is placed on a clear acrylic stand. (6) A detailed close-up shows a metallic-looking mineral with black and yellowish-green components on a clear base. The camera zooms in to show fine structural details. (7) Two crystal pendants, one clear and one smoky, are held up by their brown cords. The camera shows them side-by-side and then focuses on each separately. (8) A small, vibrant pink rectangular crystal in a transparent plastic case is presented. (9) A brown tabby cat's head enters the frame, sniffing the crystals on the table. (10) The video ends with a static shot of the mineral collection and business cards on a white surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a cheerful female voice speaking in Mandarin over a light, upbeat acoustic guitar melody. (2) As the unboxing begins, frequent sounds of crinkling paper and rustling plastic accompany the narration. A small 'thud' is heard when a crystal is placed on a surface. (3) The speaker's tone remains excited and high-pitched while describing the minerals. (4) Around the middle of the video, a clear cat meow is heard, followed by the speaker laughing and calling the cat 'stinky cat' with a playful, teasing tone. (5) The BGM continues steadily through the end, where the speaker gives a final sign-off and the audio fades out.
